intro: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!
description:
Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

You click the lamp. 
The lamp starts to glow. 
Your earnings increase. 
You feel satisfaction.

You can unlock new lamps — from ordinary candles and oil lamps… to increasingly bizarre creations you’d rather not question (yes, we’re looking at you, Toilet Lamp).

You start to wonder… does this make any sense? You keep clicking…
